Imported from role task file `tasks/section_17/section_17.7.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS` and Audit control `section_17/section_17.7/cis_17.7.3.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2025-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "17.7.3 | PATCH | Ensure Audit Authorization Policy Change is set to include Success"
  when: win25cis_rule_17_7_3
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_17.7.3
    - patch
    - NIST800-171_3.3.1
    - NIST800-171_3.3.2
    - NIST800-171_3.3.6
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-3
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-3_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-7
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-12
  block:
    - name: "17.7.3 | AUDIT | Ensure Audit Authorization Policy Change is set to include Success | Get current audit events for Authorization Policy Change"
      ansible.windows.win_shell: AuditPol /get /subcategory:"{0cce9231-69ae-11d9-bed3-505054503030}" -r | ConvertFrom-Csv | Select-Object -expand "Inclusion Setting"
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: false
      check_mode: false
      register: discovered_17_7_3_audit

    - name: "17.7.3 | PATCH | Ensure Audit Authorization Policy Change is set to include Success | Enable Success for Authorization Policy Change"
      when: "'Success' not in discovered_17_7_3_audit.stdout"
      ansible.windows.win_shell: AuditPol /set /subcategory:"{0cce9231-69ae-11d9-bed3-505054503030}" /success:enable
